title: Case 039: Permitted sign-in list for my profile
initial_request: I noticed an unusual sign-in notification for my H&V profile and want a permitted list of the sign-in sessions shown for it.
overview: Nerys Wren contacted Harrow & Vale Bank plc after a sign-in notification for a new device. Following bank identification checks and her secure portal confirmation, the agent asked the security team for an allowed session extract. The permitted extract was provided in the secure portal; the origin of the new session was not determined.

next_action.summary: The agent's immediate action is to ask the security team for a permitted session extract for Nerys's profile.

outcome: The permitted session extract was provided as sessions-039.txt in the secure portal. It records a recognised-device sign-in on 10 July 2025 and a new-device sign-in notification on 11 July 2025; the origin of the new session remains undetermined.

events.body: I generated a sign-in notification for a new device on 11 July 2025 at 08:42 UTC.

After you completed the bank identification checks, I explained that the new-device notification looked unusual and asked for a list of sign-in sessions for my profile. I did not provide or ask you to record any secrets.
I confirm that I want the permitted session extract for my profile delivered through this secure portal.
I’m escalating case HV-039 and requesting the permitted session extract for Nerys Wren’s profile. Please determine the allowed scope and exclude internal detection details and anyone else’s data.
I’ve limited the extract to the permitted session details and withheld device and network identifiers. The origin of the new session is not determined.

I’ve attached the permitted session extract, sessions-039.txt. It records a recognised-device successful sign-in at 09:15 UTC on 10 July 2025 and a new-device sign-in notification at 08:42 UTC on 11 July 2025; device and network identifiers are withheld, and the origin of the new session is not determined.
